description: Intent i006 (SNAPSHOT=s02, BRANCH=sysctl-handler-recode) complete. Searched only snapshots/s02: enumerated 86 files calling proc_dointvec/proc_dointvec_minmax/proc_doulongvec*/proc_dostring and deep-read the shadow-ctl_table and ungated-commit wrapper handlers, excluding the seed net/sctp/sysctl.c. Four reportable variants found (artifact: agent-state/findings/i006.json, all quotes verified literal in their ranges): (1) net/netfilter/ipvs/ip_vs_ctl.c:2391-2417 proc_do_sync_threshold — shadow ctl_table tmp with .data=&val stack local, proc_dointvec at 2407, commit memcpy(valp,val,sizeof(val)) at 2413 guarded only by 'if (write)', not rc; kernel/sysctl.c do_proc_dointvec:606-623 commits elements one-by-one and returns error mid-vector, so a partially parsed write can be committed and still returned as an error (sibling proc_do_sync_ports at 2420 shares the ungated shape). (2) net/ipv6/addrconf.c:6356-6379 addrconf_sysctl_forward — lctl.data=&val stack local; addrconf_fixup_forwarding (full netns forwarding commit + notifications) invoked under bare 'if (write)' and 'ret' overwritten with the fixup's return at 6378, discarding the parser error; same pattern at addrconf_sysctl_disable (6453), ignore_routes_with_linkdown (6654), disable_policy (6754). (3) kernel/utsname_sysctl.c:33-69 proc_do_uts_string — uts_table.data=tmp_data stack buffer; write-back memcpy into the persistent uts namespace at 62-63 gated only on 'if (write)', parser return r ignored before commit (tmp_data pre-initialized, so partial/stale-string commit, not uninit leak). (4) ipc/ipc_sysctl.c:51-70 proc_ipc_sem_dointvec — on error restores only ns->sem_ctls[3], leaving partially committed elements 0-2 of kernel/sem from a write userspace saw fail, and skips sem_check_semmni. Twelve other candidates (fork threads-max, pid cad_pid, fpsimd default_vl, sysrq, rps_sock_flow, dev_weight, xfs, latencytop, ftrace/trace/stack_trace, devinet, exec suid_dumpable, mptcp/tcp/smc/sctp/vsock/nf_log string handlers) were classified safe on explicit evidence (e.g. 'if (ret || !write) return ret;' or 'if (!ret && write)' gating, pre-initialized out-params). Limitations: regex/brace enumeration heuristic over 198 wrappers; s390/riscv/sh/md/sgi-xp/lockd/nfs/ocfs2/rds/tipc/unix/x25/xfrm/yama/hugetlb trees only skimmed; remaining checked~=False entries (sched/rt.c:2868, sched/topology.c:275, mm/compaction.c:2963, mm/vmstat.c:77, ndisc, s390/mm/cmm.c:262, sunrpc) unexamined, not cleared; no runtime build/test was performed against this read-only snapshot, so partial-commit reachability is reasoned from do_proc_dointvec semantics rather than demonstrated.
